answer_1.quote: Task-oriented dialog systems help users complete pre-defined tasks such as booking a hotel or reserving a table in a restaurant.

answer_2.quote: In MultiWoZ, response generation performance is evaluated by a combination of three metrics: Inform rate measures whether the system has provided an appropriate entity; Success rate measures whether the system has answered all the requested attributes; BLEU measures the fluency as compared to the references, which are also delexicalized.

answer_4.quote: Thus, we ask crowd-workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk to compare responses generated by baseline (MTTOD) and finetune+KRLS (ft+KRLS).
answer_4.guideline: The responses are rated in terms of their 1) appropriateness, 2) fluency, 3) informativeness, and 4) overall quality given a dialogue context.
